issues.title: Text collision in material hierarchy panel
issues.description: Specimen text and token metadata labels overlap horizontally due to constrained container width.
issues.evidence: Specimen text lines collide directly with ULTRATHIN, THIN, and REGULAR label columns in the preview card.
issues.suggestion: Adjust layout to stack metadata or hide underlying specimen text on narrow viewports.
issues.triageNote: fix — real: full-width specimen backdrop renders directly under the level labels (no separation), and at 360px the fixed pill+gap+spec-text row (~305px) overflows the 288px content box, clipping labels at the card edge.

issues.title: Overlapping specimen text clashing with token labels
issues.description: Background specimen text extends across the full width of the material preview container, causing it to render directly behind and collide with the token hierarchy labels and spec details.
issues.evidence: Specimen strings such as 'jumps over the lazy dog', 'laid-object surfaces', and 'elevation by refraction' overlap with 'ULTRATHIN', 'THIN', 'REGULAR' and their associated 'panel/XX' spec text.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the background specimen text container to sit strictly behind the preview glass pills on the left, or clip and separate the specimen area from the right-hand metadata column.
issues.triageNote: fix — real: backdrop div is absolute -inset-x-2 across the whole stage, so specimen lines run under the right-hand ULTRATHIN/THIN/REGULAR label column even on desktop; confirmed in source.

issues.title: Specimen overlap and label clipping
issues.description: Specimen descriptions collide with preview shapes and metadata labels overflow container boundaries.
issues.evidence: Specimen text renders behind pill elements and 'ULTRATHIN' collides with the right container edge.
issues.suggestion: Refactor layout into a single vertical stack and adjust container padding for narrow viewports.
issues.triageNote: fix — real: same full-width backdrop collision plus label column overflow at 320px (row needs ~305px vs 256px content), so ULTRATHIN/spec text hits the container edge.

issues.title: Specimen text collision
issues.description: Background specimen text overlaps directly with preview pills and token metadata labels, creating illegible rendering.
issues.evidence: Specimen 01-06 lines run underneath the layered frosted pills and collide with right-aligned token labels.
issues.suggestion: Isolate background specimen text from the token overlay pills and adjust spacing to avoid visual collisions.
issues.triageNote: fix — real: same root cause; specimen 01-06 lines run beneath the pills AND the right-aligned token labels at 320px.

issues.title: Overlapping specimen text
issues.description: Token labels and metrics render directly over background specimen body text, making both illegible.
issues.evidence: 'ULTRATHIN', 'THIN', and 'REGULAR' labels collide directly with 'specimen 02' through '06' text.
issues.suggestion: Separate token items and specimen strings into distinct layout rows or columns.
issues.triageNote: fix — real: same root cause at 390px with the page's compact gap/padding overrides; labels render over specimen body text.
